titles.title: Lake George with Crows

description: A lake stretches across the center of this semiabstract, aerial view of Lake George. Land in tones of brown and gray, dotted with trees, wraps around the lake. Three black birds fly across the lake. A gray, cloudy sky is visible in the distance.
